content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know the communication protocol used by [product_name] [version_no]. I think it might be Profinet—is that correct? Is it the same protocol as [version_no]? Thank you.

What exactly do you mean by [product_name] [version_no]? Are you referring to [product_name] [article_no]? There's an example on a [company_name] page showing communication between [version_no] controllers and [product_name] [article_no], which should also apply to [article_no]. [url]
Hi, [product_name] modules do not communicate using Profinet. Instead, they use the S7 protocol over TCP/IP. Hope this clarifies things.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked for details about the communication protocol of [product_name] modules, mistakenly assuming they support Profinet. Other users clarified that [product_name] actually uses the S7 protocol over TCP/IP and not Profinet. This shows a common confusion between protocol support of different [company_name] controller types and the need for clearer documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected [product_name] modules to be compatible with Profinet and to use the same protocol stack as [version_no] controllers for communication.
